consent.title: Cookies and optional tools
consent.body: Essential storage keeps Vibed working. Error replay and usage analytics are optional, separately controlled, and off until you choose them. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time in Cookie settings.

replay.title: Error replay
replay.body: When the editor hits an error, a short replay of the screen helps us fix it. Text, images and video are hidden.

analytics.title: Usage analytics
analytics.body: Counts the pages you visit and the features you use, so we know what to improve. Text on the page and your content are never sent.

unsubscribe.title: Email preferences
unsubscribe.body: Stop receiving the weekly summary and product updates from Vibed. You will still get emails about your account, such as payment receipts and notices before projects are deleted.
unsubscribe.done: You are unsubscribed. No more summaries or product updates will be sent to this address.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link is not valid. Use the link from a recent email, or write to us and we will unsubscribe you.
unsubscribe.error: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

planLock.failed: Checkout could not open. Try again in a moment.

designStudio.title: Design Studio is a Pro feature
designStudio.body: Thumbnails, covers and graphics with an AI design copilot are part of the Pro plan. Your videos and projects are not affected.

social.title: Publishing is a Pro feature
social.body: Publishing to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok, scheduling, and post performance analysis are part of the Pro plan. You can still download every short you export.

planner.title: The Planner is a Pro feature
planner.body: A calendar of every scheduled and published post across your projects, where you can move, cancel or mark posts as done. Publishing and scheduling are part of the Pro plan.

shorts.title: Shorts is a Creator feature
shorts.body: Turn one long video into ready-to-post vertical shorts, without re-editing by hand.
gains: Vibed finds the strongest moments and cuts them on sentence boundaries
Each short is reframed to 9:16 with captions, a hook title and the platform's safe zones
When two people sit side by side, the short can split them: host on top, guest below
Export one short or all of them in one go
shorts.without: You can still edit and export the full video, but shorts have to be cut and reframed by hand.

stock.title: Stock media is a Creator feature
stock.body: Search stock footage and images and drop them onto your timeline as b-roll.
gains: Search photos and videos by keyword from the Assets panel
AI b-roll suggestions matched to what is being said
Placed as overlays you can move, trim and animate
stock.without: You can still use your own uploaded footage and images.

editingStyles.title: Editing styles are a Creator feature
editingStyles.body: Pick Vlog, Talking head, Interview, Podcast or Reel and every command follows that style.
gains: Silence pacing, zooms, transitions and captions tuned to the style
Sound effects at the right level for the style (none for podcasts)
Suggestions that fit the format you are making
editingStyles.without: Commands still work, with the same neutral defaults for every video.

autoMode.title: Auto mode is a Creator feature
autoMode.body: One prompt edits the whole video in your chosen style, as a single undo.
gains: Clean-up, captions, zoom rhythm and animation run in order, hands-free
Each format has its own playbook: Reel, Vlog, Talking head, Interview, Podcast
Undo the whole run in one tap
autoMode.without: You can still run each edit yourself, one command at a time.

autoTrial.title: Your free Auto edits are used
autoTrial.body: Auto mode edits the whole video from one prompt. The free plan includes a few runs to try it.
gains: Unlimited Auto runs within your monthly AI operations
Every editing style, not just the default
100 AI operations a month for captions, clean-up and commands
autoTrial.without: Manual editing, silence removal and export keep working.

aiOps.title: You've used this month's AI operations
aiOps.body: Each AI command, caption pass or analysis uses one operation.
gains: More AI operations each month (unlimited on Pro)
Keep editing with Roka today instead of waiting for the reset
Longer videos and more storage
aiOps.without: Your projects, manual editing and export keep working until the monthly reset.

projects.title: You've reached your project limit
projects.body: The free plan keeps a small number of active projects.
gains: Unlimited projects
Longer storage before old projects are removed
Videos up to 90 minutes (4 hours on Pro)
projects.without: Delete a project to make room, or keep working in the ones you have.

designStudio.title: Design Studio is a Pro feature
designStudio.body: Design thumbnails, covers and social graphics next to your videos, with an AI design copilot.
gains: Describe a design and the copilot builds it, or restyles it four ways
YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and story formats with your brand kit
Background removal, components and icons, PNG export or straight onto your timeline
designStudio.without: Your videos and projects are not affected; thumbnails have to be made elsewhere.

social.title: Publishing is a Pro feature
social.body: Publish and schedule your shorts to social platforms from Vibed, then see how they perform.
gains: Schedule YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels from the Shorts panel (where each platform allows it)
AI-written titles and captions for each platform
Views, watch time and engagement per post, with editing recommendations you approve
social.without: You can still download every short and post it yourself.

planner.title: The Planner is a Pro feature
planner.body: One calendar with every scheduled and published post across all your projects.
gains: See the month at a glance: scheduled, to post by hand, and published
Move a post to another day or time, or cancel it
Stats on each published post, right in the calendar
planner.without: Without publishing you post each short yourself and keep track elsewhere.
